Bandlassian from @atlassian opened their Sydney 2026 set at the Manning Bar with a heavier take on Olivia Rodrigo's good 4 u, Lesley on lead vocals with Luke alongside.

Video shot by @sailornicole and @demonrace, with photos and video sponsored by V2 AI.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to @youngcareoz, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
